fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: étude méthodologique évaluant une approche de screening à deux étapes avec prompts dynamiques et triage basé sur la confiance.
fields.quote: first stage performs initial screening using a low-cost LLM guided by dynamically constructed few-shot prompts and provides confidence scores; the second stage re-evaluates low-confidence instances using a high-performance LLM.

fields.label: Données
fields.quote: We utilized the CLEF 2019 dataset, which includes 31 systematic reviews covering diagnosis, intervention, and prognosis, each providing PMIDs of all studies retrieved [14].
fields.note: chunk_id corrigé : le LLM citait 'arxiv-2512-11261_p5_c2', la citation est dans arxiv-2512-11261_p5_c1

fields.label: Modèles
fields.quote: To provide a more comprehensive comparative analysis, we further evaluated several representative open-weight general and medical-specific LLMs under the zero-shot setting, including Phi-3.5-mini [33], MediPhi [34], Gemma3-4B [35], Med-Gemma-4B [36], and Med-Gemma-27B [36].

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: DFS a obtenu des scores F1 supérieurs dans la tâche de filtrage titre et résumé sur les dix revues systématiques, par rapport aux méthodes Zero-Shot, Chain-of-Thought et Few-Shot.
fields.quote: DFS achieved higher F1 scores in the title and abstract screening task across all ten systematic reviews compared to Zero-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, and Few-Shot methods.

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: L'étude a été limitée par la taille des données et des coûts computationnels, et des faux négatifs subsistent.
fields.quote: First, due to data access constraints and computational costs, the scale of this study was relatively limited; evaluating the approach on larger-scale datasets would help further validate its robustness.
